Your Job

Are you an inventive engineer driven by solving complex problems and bringing cutting-edge product designs to life? At Molex, we are looking for a passionate Product Development Engineer to join our High Voltage Connector team, where your expertise in fundamental engineering principles and critical thinking will directly influence the development of advanced, high-performance products.

In this role, you will leverage powerful design tools such as CAD, tolerance analysis, FEA, FMEA, and DVP&R to create innovative solutions and overcome technical challenges. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, take ownership of product designs, and contribute to delivering outstanding results within schedule - supported by mentorship from experienced leaders.

: Wolfsburg OR Munich preferred - Remote in Germany as an option for a great fit!

Our Team

You will be working with engineering, production, operations cross functionally at a global scope. Most of team members within your team are based across the globe. You will be directly reporting to the Engineering Manager High Power Europe/India.

- Support concept development, ensuring designs are manufacturable, cost-effective, and meet customer requirements.

Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field
- Extensive experience in product design and its workflows
- Solid understanding of CAD/3D Modelling, Plastic, and Injection Molding
- Experience using analytical studies (FEA, tolerance stacks, DFMEA, etc.) as part of a product development process
- Solid knowledge of validation plans and analysing test results to ensure a product meets performance requirements
- Demonstrated ability to use structured problem-solving methods to systematically determine root causes for complex technical issues
- Ability to travel approximately 20% (international)
- Fluent in English and German

What Will Put You Ahead

- Product design experience in the automotive industry, preferably in connector design
- Automotive High Voltage Connector development knowledge and experience
- Knowledge of resins, metals, engineering tools and processes, and manufacturing processes (injection molding, stamping, plating, assembly)

jobs.description:
html Maintenance Technician (all genders)Garching / Full-time / Permanent employee About us

Blackwave designs, manufactures and ships flight-qualified, commercial off-the-shelf composite overwrapped pressure vessels (COPVs) for launch vehicles and satellites. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Munich, Germany, the company delivers COPVs from a standardized portfolio with flight heritage. The approach reduces lead time from months to days while ensuring that each tank is qualified and flight-ready. Blackwave's mission is to end COPV failure in spaceflight. The company employs more than 150 people across manufacturing facilities in Germany and Texas.

More information at Blackwave.com and the procurement platform COPV.com.

Maintenance Technician (all genders)
Garching / Full-time / Permanent employee YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

The What:

Keep our production running.

You make sure our machines don’t stop. In a fast-scaling production environment, you take ownership of maintenance, reliability, and quick problem solving — keeping our operations stable while we grow.

The Why:

To end COPV failure in spaceflight. The benchmark for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency. Our logistics determine whether materials are in the right place at the right time. Without flow, there is no production. Without precision, there is no reliability. Without structure, there is no scaling. Logistics is the pacemaker and heart of the mission.

Your tasks in detail and priorities:

- Maintain critical systems: Perform regular maintenance on our machines and ensure operational readiness
- Own machine reliability: Identify weak points early and prevent failures before they happen
- Support new equipment: Assist in selecting, installing, and ramping up new machines
- Document what matters: Keep maintenance, changes, and actions clearly and reliably documented
- Fix issues hands-on: Analyze faults systematically and resolve them directly on the shopfloor
- Work across boundaries: Collaborate closely with production, engineering, and external partners
- Build structure in growth: Help bring order, standards, and reliability to a rapidly growing machine park

YOUR PROFILE

- Solid technical background: Training as a mechatronics technician, industrial mechanic, electrician, or similar
- Hands-on experience: Experience in maintenance of industrial machines and equipment
- Technical versatility: Ideally familiar with machines such as CNC (milling/turning), presses, robots/cobots, or HVAC systems
- Structured working style: You work cleanly, stay organized, and document your work properly
- Problem-solving mindset: You go to the root cause and fix issues sustainably
- Hands-on mentality: You step in where needed — even beyond your core area
- Communication skills: Comfortable working with internal teams and external service providers
- Language skills: German required (at least B2), English at working level (at least B1)

WHAT WE OFFER

- High level of autonomy & real impact: Be part of shaping our high-tech production landscape
- Flexible working hours & remote work options based on mutual agreement
- Startup mindset meets aerospace innovation: Flat hierarchies, fast decisions, and space for your ideas
- Choose your own benefit: Germany ticket, Egym Wellpass, or a tax-free Give Card
- Healthy & social lunch culture: Enjoy fresh meals during shared lunch breaks
- Stunning views: Wind down on our rooftop terrace with breathtaking views of the Alps in Taufkirchen or enjoy our indoor garden in Garching-Hochbrück
- Growth opportunities: Work on exciting projects and learn from inspiring people
- We live our team culture: From tech talks to team events and after-work gatherings – we celebrate success togeth

The Opportunity

We are looking for an SAP HANA Performance Team Leader to plan, execute, and validate the performance of SAP HANA on Nutanix AHV and AOS. This role is responsible for qualifying our software to meet SAP benchmark targets and certifying third-party OEM servers for inclusion in SAP’s certified hardware directory.

About the Team

Nutanix's Solutions & Performance Engineering team is a globally distributed organization of architects, performance engineers, and industry specialists focused on validating, optimizing, and accelerating customer success across strategic workloads and industry ecosystems.

Your Role

- Manage a team of remote employees and subcontractors to benchmark SAP HANA and other SAP software components on bare-metal servers. Virtualize similar configurations on Nutanix AHV using the same hardware to identify and improve performance differences between virtualization and bare metal.
- Deploy and troubleshoot various SAP HANA configurations, and establish and document the Nutanix best practices for this workload.
- Identify new strategies and configurations to improve SAP HANA performance on new software versions and denser hardware specifications that expose performance issues in the platform software.
- Work with core engineering teams to troubleshoot performance issues impacting SAP HANA and determine root causes that can be corrected through code changes.
- Deploy new hardware infrastructure in the SAP Linux lab in Walldorf, Germany, and manage infrastructure dependencies.
- Build strong relationships at SAP Headquarters in Walldorf, Germany to gain support from key stakeholders.
- Align Nutanix strategic outcomes with SAP strategic outcomes and influence SAP stakeholders to support Nutanix goals.
- Guide teams in using SAP HANA test harness tools, including SAP validation and certification suites. Serve as a subject matter expert to support performance teams in qualifying and certifying our solution.
- Analyze results from SAP validation and certification suites, compare them to SAP's KPI thresholds, diagnose failures, and drive issues to root cause across the full stack.
- Provision, configure, and troubleshoot SAP HANA parameters, SLES/RHEL for SAP tuning, vCPU/NUMA topology, kernel scheduling, general storage topologies, virtual storage controllers, and network fabrics.
- Experience with automating hardware and software deployments, infrastructure as code, and APIs.
- Ability to explore how AI can be used to automate processes further using advanced AI models.
- Understand the impact of new CPU and memory innovations on SAP HANA workloads and how Nutanix AHV and AOS must evolve to achieve performance benchmarks close to bare metal.
- Understand both scale-up and scale-out HANA and other key architectures of the SAP HANA database.
- Assist in producing written artifacts including SAP Notes, best practice guides, test plans, and KPI result packages for SAP submissions.
- Develop sizing guidelines, configuration recommendations, and reference architectures for SAP HANA on Nutanix AHV/AOS.
- Help customers and Nutanix sellers on large deals involving SAP HANA.
- Work with hardware OEMs to enable them to achieve their own hardware validations for SAP HANA with Nutanix.
- Assist with Nutanix support escalations.

What You Will Bring

- 5+ years in SAP HANA infrastructure or general database performance engineering, with at least 2 years focused on virtualized HANA.
- Deep Linux OS experience
- Experience with Nutanix HCI
- Performance monitoring tools
- Hands-on experience running SAP HANA test harness validation and certification suites, interpreting KPI results, especially storage latency and throughput tests, and understanding the reasons for test failures.
- Working knowledge of SAP HANA, the SAP HANA hardware directory, and, ideally, SAP's certification requirements for HCI and virtualized deployments.
- Strong Linux performance skills on SLES for SAP or RHEL for SAP, including hugepages, C-states and power governors, NUMA topology, SNC2, I/O schedulers, and the standard observability toolkit (perf, sar, iostat, blktrace, numastat, ftrace).
- Practical experience with virtualization performance, including CPU pinning and NUMA alignment, vCPU-to-pCPU ratios, memory reservation, and virtual storage and network path behavior.
- Nutanix AHV/AOS experience is strongly preferred. ESXi or KVM experience will be considered if the candidate can demonstrate relevant expertise.
- Comfortable with distributed storage concepts, including replication factor, data locality, write path and oplog behavior, and understanding latency percentiles.
- Scripting for automation and analysis (Python, Bash) and familiarity with Ansible or Terraform for repeatable lab builds.
- Excellent communication skills in both English and German, with the ability to engage meaningfully with customers.

Great to have

- Direct involvement in prior SAP HANA hardware, HCI, or cloud certification submissions.
- Experience with SAP HANA System Replication, scale-out landscapes, and HA/DR validation under fault injection.
- Familiarity with SAP application-layer benchmarking (SD benchmark, BW/4HANA or S/4HANA workload profiles) in addition to infrastructure KPIs.
- Nutanix certification (NCP/NCM) or SAP HANA Technology certification.

jobs.description:
For our location in Zeuthen we are seeking:

Senior Software Developer

Remuneration Group 13 | Limited: 2 years with the option to extend | Starting date: 01.12.2026 | ID: APMA007/2026 | Deadline: 11.10.2026 | Full-time/Part-time | Remote work possible

DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.

The Photo Injector Test Facility PITZ in Zeuthen (near Berlin) is one of the leading international groups for developing modern photo injectors and their applications. Current R&D goals of PITZ include improving the electron source brightness beyond state of the art for X‑ray Free Electron Lasers as well as applications of high brightness beams, e. g. for most modern cancer radiation therapies like FLASH‑RT and SFRT (FLASHlab@PITZ). The Cherenkov Telescope Array Observatory (CTAO) is the next-generation, ground-based facility for very-high-energy gamma-ray astronomy. It will feature two massive telescope arrays deployed across both the Northern and Southern hemispheres. Operations and scientific data acquisition within the observatory are managed by the Array Control and Data Acquisition (ACADA) system. Within ACADA, the Resource Manager (RM) handles infrastructure administration and system supervision, while the Central Control (CC) orchestrates the execution of astronomical observation workflows.

As software developer, you will work for PITZ to develop server software for the accelerator control system, as well as for the ACADA system's RM and CC subsystems.

About your role:

- Development of server software for the control of different devices at PITZ using the DOOCS API
- Integration of applications into the accelerator control system
- Design and implement core operational subsystems as distributed, container-based software based on structural and behavioural design models
- Develop the orchestration logic to manage dynamic hardware groupings and automate workflows, alongside hierarchical, fault-tolerant architectures for system lifecycles and automated recovery

About you:

- University degree in computer science, physics, mathematics, engineering or related subject, or comparable qualification
- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
- Strong professional experience in C++ and Java; proficiency in Python is advantageous
- Deep knowledge of OOP, functional programming, data structures, and concurrency/multithreading
- Familiarity with state-machine design patterns and distributed consensus mechanisms.
- Proven background in control systems, real-time programming, process automation, or SCADA architectures
- Experience developing communication protocols for hardware and device interfacing
- Strong proficiency in Linux environments and modern DevOps practices (TDD, CI/CD, build automation, Git)
- Strong English communication skills for collaborating in an international, multi-disciplinary team
- Good German communication skills are preferable

Good reasons to join:

- An international research campus enables you to think outside the box
- Basic, materials and applied research broaden your horizons
- Collaborate with exceptional colleagues and researchers
- Our own particle accelerator

Look forward to a unique working environment on our international research campus. Respectful cooperation and the well-being of our DESY employees are particularly important to us. Gender equality is an important aspect for us. To support work life balance we offer flexible working hours, variable part-time, job-sharing models and participation in mobile work (up to 50 %). You will benefit from our family-friendly and collegial atmosphere, our established health management and occupational pension provision. As a public funded employer, we offer you a secure workplace and facilitate your individual career with our comprehensive training and development opportunities. Remuneration is according to the regulations of the TV‑AVH. DESY offers its employees a financial supplement for a German job ticket (Deutschland-Ticket) at both locations.

For our location in Zeuthen we are seeking:

PhD student for TIQTOC optical atomic clock experiment for Ultra-light Dark Matter

Remuneration Group E13 | Limited: 3 years | Starting date: 01.01.2027 | ID: APDO006/2026 | Deadline: open | Part-time

DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.

The Zeuthen location of DESY has a strong focus on astroparticle and particle physics (gamma-ray and neutrino astronomy, and collider particle physics). The experimental groups are accompanied by a strong theory group. DESY Zeuthen is responsible for developing and delivering detectors for astroparticle and particle physics experiments, and is actively engaged in R&D for future applications.

With the Centre for Quantum Technology and Applications (CQTA), DESY Zeuthen is taking a leading role in applying quantum technology to challenges in particle and astroparticle physics. A new search for the effects of ultralight dark matter is being constructed, using ultra-sensitive optical atomic clocks as the sensing element. The post holder will contribute to this search, developing a test setup for networked clock comparison and frequency stabilisation. The post holder will also help to develop the procedures to collect and analyse the frequency comparisons, forming the basis of fundamental physics searches for (e.g.) ultralight dark matter.

About your role:

- Active role in developing test infrastructure for optical atomic clocks and comparison to reference clocks
- Develop instrumentation for measuring fundamental constants
